sijia-liu.name: Dr. Sijia Liu (刘思嘉 博士)
sijia-liu.affiliation: Institute of Geotechnical Engineering, BOKU University
sijia-liu.summary: Specializes in advanced phase-field modeling of rock fracture, anisotropic damage mechanics, and thermodynamically consistent constitutive frameworks.
interests: Thermodynamically consistent phase-field models for frictional fracture in brittle & quasi-brittle rocks
Higher-order phase-field formulations for anisotropic rock damage and localized shearing
Cohesive interface elements and mixed-mode fracture propagation in rock-like materials
Coupled hydro-mechanical (HM) phase-field formulations for fluid-driven fractures

guanglei-zhou.name: Dr. Guanglei Zhou (周光磊 博士)
guanglei-zhou.affiliation: Institute of Geotechnical Engineering, BOKU University
guanglei-zhou.summary: Focuses on thermo-hydro-mechanical (THM) coupled processes, creep deformation and fatigue damage in deep underground energy storage reservoirs.
interests: Thermo-hydro-mechanical (THM) behavior of fractured rock masses under high confining stresses
Time-dependent creep, fatigue degradation, and damage evolution around deep cavern walls
Long-term geomechanical integrity of compressed air energy storage (CAES) and salt caverns
Continuum damage modeling and multi-physics coupling numerical simulations

lingfeng-guo.summary: Specializes in multiscale constitutive modeling of granular media, peridynamics (PD) dynamic failure, and European Commission geomechanics projects.

Multiscale micromechanics and discrete-continuum coupling (DEM-FEM / DEM-PD)
